ul.li: TicketService is the transaction boundary. Number allocation, the ticket write, audit entries, and the outbox row all commit together. Nothing below it opens its own transaction — that is what would break the guarantee.
TicketStateMachine is a real component, not documentation. Diagram 07 is enforced here; illegal transitions are rejected at the domain layer, not left to the UI to prevent.
SheetRowProjector lives in the worker, not the API. Denormalization is a boundary concern (FR-24) — the database keeps IDs, and names are resolved only when a sheet row is being built.
RowLocator is the component that keeps rev 1's bug from returning. It resolves a row by row_key, never by remembered position.
Only outbox_w talks to Redis for dispatch, and only after commit. Dispatch inside the transaction races the worker.
This is the same decomposition as the Structurizr component view in workspace.dsl. Two renderings, one design — if you change one, change both.
